intro:
HSR to Shenzhen; chartered car all day
Robot 6S Store and AI 6S Store, Longgang
INNO100: exoskeletons, smart glasses
Sunset at Shenzhen Bay; coconut chicken dinner

items.title: K Hotel → Guangzhou South Station (广州南站)
Enter station and wait
items.note: HSR tickets should be bought in advance on 12306. Enter by scanning the ID used for booking.
items.tip: HSR tickets should be bought in advance on 12306. Enter by scanning the ID used for booking.

items.title: HSR: Guangzhou South → Shenzhen North (深圳北)
items.note: ~35 min. Shenzhen North is closest to Bantian, Longgang.

items.title: Shenzhen North → Bantian, Longgang (龙岗坂田)
items.note: Meet the local chartered car at Shenzhen North. Drive ~25 min.. The exact exit is agreed with the driver.
items.tip: Price, hours, and whether tolls and parking are included should be agreed before the charter.

route.title: Shenzhen North Station → Galaxy WORLD
route.pick: Private-car drop-off/pick-up area at Shenzhen North Station; confirm the exit with the driver by phone after leaving the station
route.drop: At the Galaxy WORLD (星河WORLD) campus entrance, Bantian, Longgang; exact spot unconfirmed

items.title: Robot 6S Store (机器人6S店)
items.note: In the Galaxy WORLD (星河WORLD) campus, Bantian, Longgang. The world's first robot 6S store. Open 10:00–21:00; a ~10-min robot street show starts at 11:00 (moved indoors if it rains).

route.title: Robots cooking on site
route.desc: Jianbing (煎饼果子) and coffee are made by robots on site; they can be bought and eaten.

route.title: Humanoid robot zone
route.desc: Humanoid robots and robot dogs from leading Chinese makers such as Leju (乐聚), Unitree (宇树) and DEEP Robotics (云深处) are demonstrated live.

route.title: Robot parts supermarket
route.desc: Core parts such as servo motors and reducers are shelved like a supermarket. Robots can also be rented, from ~1,000 yuan per day.

items.title: Lunch: Galaxy WORLD COCO Park (星河WORLD COCO Park)
items.note: In the same Galaxy WORLD campus as the Robot 6S Store. Restaurants are concentrated in the mall; no further ride needed.

food.name: Tai Er Sauerkraut Fish (太二酸菜鱼)
food.desc: Popular pickled-cabbage fish chain. Sour, spicy, appetising.

food.name: Chao Xiao Zhan (潮小栈)
food.desc: Chaoshan food: rice noodles, beef balls. ~35 yuan per person.

food.name: Yunhaiyao (云海肴)
food.desc: Yunnan food: steam-pot chicken, wild mushrooms. Milder flavours, suitable for kids.

items.tip: These restaurant names come from older sources; what is in the mall on the day applies.

items.title: AI 6S Store (人工智能6S店)
items.note: In the same Galaxy WORLD robot street, not far from the Robot 6S Store; likely walkable (exact unit unconfirmed). Mostly for makers, developers and brand incubation: of interest to adults for AI hardware; can be skipped by kids.

items.title: Chartered car: Longgang → Shenzhen Bay, Nanshan
items.note: Drive ~40 min.. The driver waits near Galaxy WORLD in the morning; agree beforehand whether the car waits all day and how that is charged.

route.title: Galaxy WORLD → Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza
route.pick: At the Galaxy WORLD campus entrance; the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: Near the northeast entrance, North Hall L1, Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza; the exact spot is agreed with the driver

items.title: INNO100
items.note: Level 1, North Hall, Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza (northeast entrance, by Talent Park). Open daily 10:00–22:00; free, walk-in. Exoskeletons and smart glasses can be tried. Robot demos and the 3D-printing workshop should be asked about or booked ahead.

route.title: Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza (深圳湾文化广场)
route.desc: A new cultural landmark of Shenzhen. The architecture itself photographs well.

route.title: Talent Park and Shenzhen Bay Park (人才公园、深圳湾公园)
route.desc: Seafront promenade for sunset; in late December the sun sets around 17:50. After dark, the towers across the water are lit up, best seen from Talent Park.
route.pick: Outside the North Hall, Shenzhen Bay Culture Plaza; the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: A drop-off point near Talent Park (人才公园); the exact spot is agreed with the driver

items.title: Dinner: Shenzhen Bay area

food.name: Runyuan Siji Coconut Chicken (润园四季椰子鸡)
food.desc: Shenzhen's popular coconut chicken hotpot. Light and sweet, not oily; kids usually like the broth.

food.name: Bahe Li Haiji Beef Hotpot (八合里海记牛肉火锅)
food.desc: Chaoshan beef hotpot: hand-beaten beef balls, diaolong (吊龙) cut.

food.name: Restaurants at MixC Shenzhen Bay (深圳湾万象城)
food.desc: Many choices in the mall; easy to get back in the car afterwards.

items.tip: Coconut chicken and beef hotpot are both chains; the driver should be asked to go to the branch nearest Shenzhen Bay.
items.note: The car picks the group up outside the restaurant; tell the driver which one once chosen.

items.title: Chartered car: Nanshan → Shenzhen North
items.note: Drive ~30 min. When booking, trains from Futian Station (福田站) can also be compared.

route.title: Dinner restaurant → Shenzhen North Station
route.pick: Outside the dinner restaurant; the exact spot is agreed with the driver
route.drop: Private-car drop-off area at Shenzhen North Station; the exact spot is agreed with the driver

items.title: HSR: Shenzhen North → Guangzhou South
items.note: ~20:00 train; ~45 min is left to enter the station and clear security. The exact train should be checked on 12306.
